violations.detail: Peaking block; final week volume (9) should be substantially below week 1 (9). Got 100%.

raw_text:
PLAN "3-Week Peaking Block for Powerlifting Meet"

TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "peak for meet in 21 days"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Week 1 of taper" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Squat Focus - Day 1":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 3x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Accessory Stabilizers":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          calves_raise 3x12 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Deadlift/Bench Light Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x2 rpe 9 rest 210 seconds
          incline_press 3x4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          overhead_stretch 4 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2: Week 2 of taper" (1 week):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Squat/Bench Touch-and-Go":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 2x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Technical Work and Mobility":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pause_bench_press 2x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          grip_tricep_extension 3x8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Meet Prep - Volume Minimal":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x2 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x2 rpe 9 rest 210 seconds
          incline_press 2x3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 4 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3: Week 3 (Meet Week) - Taper to Fresh" (1 week):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Final Light Squat/Bench":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 1x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          pulling_practice 3x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Technical Priority":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x2 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mopen 3 minutes
      DAY Saturday meet_day "Meet Day - Peak":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 1x1 rpe 9 rest 240 seconds
          bench_press 1x1 rpe 9 rest 240 seconds
          deadlift 1x1 rpe 9 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_walk 5 minutes

Note:
- Rep ranges use two dots: 3x3, 2x2, etc. RPE targets are set to prioritize peak freshness.
- Rest times align with powerlifting meet prep norms and should be strictly followed.
- Warmups include basic cardio and mobility; adjust to athlete's feel on meet week.
- If any exercise conflicts with meet attempts, substitute with the same movement family at low volume (e.g., substitute incline_press with dumbbell_press if needed) using the same rep scheme.
